$comment: Data for Get-EvidenceAugmentation. Code in scripts/evidence_augmentation.py reads this and holds no domain content of its own. Edit here, not in the script.

layers.purpose: structure you already own - reuse the scaffold
layers.contributes: Approach sections, phases, workstreams, success criteria, pricing shapes, playbooks. Needs no clearance: this material is method, not client detail.
Actual program shapes, scale figures, constraints and outcomes. Mostly renders anonymized.
Current AI and product work, architecture decisions, IP. Founder/venture work, never client delivery.

layers.purpose: market framing - cite, do not claim
layers.contributes: Market sizing, benchmarks and external analysis that make a document current. Third-party throughout.
Positioning language, approved claim set and tone. Use for consistency; never count it as proof.

renderingModes.NAME_OK: Name the client and quote directly.
renderingModes.ANONYMIZE: Use the substance in full; render the client as the supplied descriptor.
renderingModes.METHOD_OWN: Your own method or IP. Reuse freely as your approach.
renderingModes.CITE_ONLY: Attribute to the external source. Never present as your own work.
renderingModes.VOICE_ONLY: Tone and approved claims only. Not evidence for a new claim.

renderingRules.$comment: Evaluated in order. First match wins. rootPrefix matches the leading digits of source_root.

anonymousDescriptors.$comment: subsector -> how to describe that client in outbound copy. Fallback builds 'a <subsector> organization' from the facet value.

invariant: Facts (scale, duration, constraint, outcome, your role) transfer verbatim with a citation. Framing adapts. Never invent a fact to fit a frame.
